name: halo_fft128_reference
description: HALO-inspired stateful FFT proxy (Phase A2): curated third-party r22sdf 128-point R2^2SDF streaming FFT reference under a PEWeaver-owned name-isolation wrapper. Reference-only fixture: it has no sharing miter and no expected-equivalence contract, so it is deliberately excluded from the formal-equivalence and synthesis-proxy corpora and is verified by the dedicated directed Verilator regression (fft128_regression.py) with an independent pure-Python bit-accurate arithmetic oracle (fft128_oracle.py). No formal proof and no HALO, clinical, or PPA claim.

upstream.role: HALO-inspired stateful FFT proxy; not HALO RTL

interfaces.clock: single clock; all state updates on posedge; asynchronous active-high reset
interfaces.reset: active-high asynchronous; clears control state; delay-line state drains while di_en is low
interfaces.input: di_en with 16-bit two's-complement di_re/di_im; exactly 128 consecutive valid samples per transaction, natural order
interfaces.output: do_en with 16-bit two's-complement do_re/do_im; exactly 128 consecutive valid samples per transaction, bit-reversed order, scaled by 1/128
interfaces.fixed_point: signed Q1.15 (WIDTH=16) samples and twiddles; per-stage arithmetic right shift by 1 with alternating round-half-up bias; modulo wrap on accumulator paths
interfaces.backpressure: none; streaming interface with no ready/stall handshake

performance.sustained_throughput: one 128-sample transaction per 128 input cycles in streaming use

mode_switch.preconditions: no new input acceptance while reset is asserted; in-flight transaction must be abandoned or drained before the next one starts

stimulus.provenance: Upstream r22sdf sim/fft_128 vectors at pinned revision f7dca6e548e1370b69a09382d30609ee14ba4a57 (ModelSim goldens); SHA-256 recorded in upstream.vector_files and third_party/r22sdf/README.md. Used here for interface/control validation and golden reproduction; the goldens are upstream ModelSim captures, not an independent numerical FFT oracle.

objective.primary: establish a verified stateful reference instance for later sharing experiments; no optimization claim in Phase A2

constraints.correctness: directed regression reproduces upstream goldens with documented 137-cycle latency
constraints.schedule: transactions are separated by reset plus idle drain, or stream back-to-back

formal_boundary: No formal equivalence proof exists for this fixture. The full 128-point fixed-point arithmetic is not formally proved; verification is the directed Verilator regression plus the independent arithmetic oracle fft128_oracle.py (a simulation model, not a proof).
